messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up: Datadog and CloudBridge asked for an on-prem observability kit we can co-brand and link from Marketplace listing. Want OTEL + dashboard + cost playbook. Target: 2026-05-20.
Evan Ross: Key constraint is span/metric cardinality from model_id and prompt_token tags. We'll include sampling presets and hashing for metrics.
Jamie Liu: Propose 3 dashboards: infra (GPU), model perf (latency, p95/p99), and cost (ingest, token counts). Small default view for low-ingest customers.
Nico Ortega: For GPUs, include DCGM mapping and a tiny scrape script. Map names: dcgm_sm_util -> gpu.sm_util, dcgm_fb_used -> gpu.memory_bytes, dcgm_power_draw -> gpu.power_watts.
Maya Patel: Packaging plan: ZIP with OTEL collector config, Datadog JSON dashboards, README quickstart, co-branded one-pager, and a demo script. Host ZIP on docs and link from Marketplace.
Evan Ross: OTEL snippet for initial bundle (sampling shown):
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
processors:
  sampling:
    tail:
      probability: 0.01
  attributes:
    actions:
      - key: model_id
        action: hash
exporters:
  datadog:
    api:
      key: ${DD_API_KEY}
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [sampling, attributes]
      exporters: [datadog]
```
Jamie Liu: We'll create a lightweight dashboard variant that works even when sampling is on. Screenshots will show that.
Datadog Bot: Datadog can provide dashboard JSON and recommended ingestion controls. ETA for templates: 2026-04-14. Include billing docs link in kit.
Maya Patel: Marketing asks for a 1-pager + 2-slide demo. Legal needs logo guidelines. Dana/Legal, please confirm.
Evan Ross: I'll add a span validator middleware and tests to repo. Will include a mode that writes full spans to file for audit while sending hashed attributes to Datadog.
Nico Ortega: I'll add DCGM scrape example and a Prometheus job snippet for reference.
Maya Patel: Weekly sync Fridays 9am PT starting 2026-03-27. Putting action items in tracker: https://brief.link/rw-obs-onprem-kit. Thanks all.
